camel_example: aliyun domain RegistrantProfileRealNameVerification --region cn-hangzhou --IdentityCredentialType SFZ --IdentityCredential 'dGVzdA==' --IdentityCredentialNo 430125123456780000 --RegistrantProfileID 1234567 --version 2018-01-29 --method POST --force
description_en: Invoke the RegistrantProfileRealNameVerification API to submit real-name verification for an information template
description_zh: 调用RegistrantProfileRealNameVerification接口提交信息模板实名认证
kebab_example: aliyun domain registrant-profile-real-name-verification --registrant-profile-id 1234567 --identity-credential dGVzdA== --identity-credential-no 430125123456780000 --identity-credential-type SFZ --region cn-hangzhou
name: RegistrantProfileRealNameVerification

parameters.help_en: User IP address. You can set it to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
Language for error messages returned by the API. Valid values:  
zh: Chinese.  
en: English.

Default value is en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认值为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: ID of the information template to undergo identity verification. This ID is automatically generated by the system after the information template is successfully created. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.html API to query the information template ID
parameters.help_zh: 待实名认证的信息模板的编号。信息模板创建成功后由系统自动生成，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.html接口查询信息模板编号
parameters.name: registrant_profile_id

parameters.help_en:
Upload the Base64-encoded image of your identity verification documents. Image requirements:  
Format must be JPG or BMP.  
Original image size must be between 55 KB and 1 MB
parameters.help_zh:
上传采用Base64编码的实名认证资料图片。图片要求如下：
图片格式为JPG或BMP。
原图片大小为55KB~1MB
parameters.name: identity_credential

parameters.help_en:
Enter the certificate number used for identity verification.

For example, an identity card number or business license number. The certificate number must exactly match the number on the submitted certificate. For enterprise certificates, enter the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code shown on the certificate
parameters.help_zh:
填写实名认证证件号码。

例如身份证号码、营业执照号码等，证件号码需要与实名认证证件上的号码完全一致。企业类的证件需填写证件上的18位统一社会信用代码
parameters.name: identity_credential_no

parameters.help_en:
Certificate type for identity verification. Select the certificate type you use for identity verification. Valid values:  
SFZ: Identity card.  
HZ: Passport.  
YYZZ: Business license.  
ORG: Organization code certificate.  
XYDM: Unified Social Credit Code certificate.  
TXZ: Mainland Travel Permits for Hong Kong and Macao Residents.

For more certificate types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72209.html
parameters.help_zh:
实名认证证件类型，选择您用于实名认证的证件类型。取值：
SFZ：身份证。
HZ：护照。
YYZZ：营业执照。
ORG：组织机构代码证。
XYDM：统一社会信用代码证书。
TXZ：港澳居民来往内地通行证。

更多证件类型的取值请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72209.html
parameters.name: identity_credential_type
